fields.label: Professional journey — paragraph 1
fields.value: My work has included developing inspection and measurement methods for automotive polymer components, biomedical-related manufacturing, sawn wood surfaces, additive manufacturing, and engineering materials.

fields.label: Professional journey — paragraph 2
fields.value: At Halmstad University, I worked as a Post-Doctoral Researcher (March 2024–March 2026) and Research Engineer (July 2023–January 2024). Earlier, I pursued doctoral research in Manufacturing Technology at Chalmers University of Technology and Halmstad University (2018–2023).

fields.label: Technical expertise
fields.value: Quality engineering (MSA, SPC, DOE, RCA, verification and validation); surface metrology and characterisation; injection moulding and additive manufacturing; measurement instrumentation; Python, MATLAB and engineering data analysis.

fields.label: Card 1 — category
fields.value: Automotive · Injection Moulding Research

fields.label: Card 1 — title
fields.value: Surface Quality Assessment of Textured Automotive Polymer Components

fields.label: Card 1 — description
fields.value: Research on surface texture characterisation and quality assessment of injection-moulded automotive interior polymers, including PC-ABS, ABS and PP. Work investigated surface measurement methods and the effects of manufacturing parameters. Related funding and research programmes include Vinnova, FFI, Produktion2030, Robust Injection Moulding of Automotive Components with Low Environmental Impact (2018-02689), and Robust Texture Design for Circular Polymers — ROPY (2022-02459). Follow-on ROPY2 work is part of the broader automotive research experience.

fields.label: Card 4 — title
fields.value: Surface Characterisation and Post-Processing in Additive Manufacturing

fields.label: Card 4 — description
fields.value: Research on surface texture, manufacturing parameters and post-processing of additively manufactured components. The FDM surface texture study acknowledged support from VINNOVA and Produktion2030 through DiSAM, as well as the Knowledge Foundation's Business Model Innovation project.

fields.label: Card 5 — category
fields.value: Dental Applications · Research Collaboration

fields.label: Card 5 — title
fields.value: Quality Assurance of 3D-Printed Biocompatible Materials for Dental Applications

fields.label: Card 5 — description
fields.value: A joint research effort between Halmstad University researchers and maxillofacial doctors at Region Halland hospital in Halmstad. The work assessed stereolithography-based biocompatible materials for dental applications, including material and quality-assurance considerations.

fields.label: Card 6 — category
fields.value: Materials Research · Lead-Free Brass

fields.label: Card 6 — title
fields.value: Surface Integrity of Machined Lead and Lead-Free Brass

fields.label: Card 6 — description
fields.value: Part of the Lead Free Brass research project funded by MISTRA (the Swedish Foundation for Strategic Environmental Research) and SIO (Swedish Strategic Innovation Area). The research investigated turned lead brass (CuZn39Pb3) and lead-free brass (CuZn21Si3P), comparing surface topography and subsurface deformation to inform material and machining evaluations.
